questions.question: Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows. Problem: Frequent power outages in urban residential complexes. Course of Action: I. The utility company should install backup generators in all complexes. Action II. The company should conduct a thorough audit of the local power grid to identify and repair faulty infrastructure. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Problem: Frequent power outages in urban residential complexes.

Course of Action: I. The utility company should install backup generators in all complexes.

Action II. The company should conduct a thorough audit of the local power grid to identify and repair faulty infrastructure. ?
questions.solution:
I. The utility company should install backup generators in all complexes. → Does not follows

This action is impractical and unrealistic. It shifts responsibility to a temporary solution instead of addressing the root cause and would be costly and inefficient for the utility company.

II. The company should conduct a thorough audit of the local power grid to identify and repair faulty infrastructure. → Follows

It directly address the cause of frequent outages and is logical, preventive and long term.

Thus, Only II follows.

questions.question: If 6 @ 4 = 25 and 12 @ 6 = 74. Then 16 @ 4 = ?
questions.solution:
6 @ 4 = 25 → (6 × 4) + 1 = 24 + 1 ⇒ 25

12 @ 6 = 74 → (12 × 6) + 2 = 72 + 2 ⇒ 74

16 @ 4 = ? → (16 × 4) + 3 = 64 + 3 ⇒ 67

questions.question: If 'P' denotes 'addition', 'D' denotes 'subtraction', 'S' denotes 'multiplication', and 'V' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression? (96 V 8 P 50 D 12 S 4 P 6) D (50 V 5 S 3 D 8 S 3) = ?

If 'P' denotes 'addition', 'D' denotes 'subtraction', 'S' denotes 'multiplication', and 'V' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression?

questions.solution:

⇒ (96 ÷ 8 + 50 - 12 × 4 + 6) - (50 ÷ 5 × 3 - 8 × 3) = ? ⇒ (12 + 50 - 12 × 4 + 6) - (10 × 3 - 8 × 3) = ? ⇒ (12 + 50 + 6 - 48) - (30 - 24) = ? ⇒ (68 - 48) - 6 = ? ⇒ 20 - 6 = ? ⇒ 14 = ?

questions.question: The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is TRUE based on the given statements. Statements: X > Y = Z A ≥ B < Y O = X = P B > Q > R Conclusions: I. Y = O II. Y < O
questions.questionHtml:
The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is TRUE based on the given statements.

Statements:

X > Y = Z

A ≥ B < Y

O = X = P

B > Q > R

Conclusions:

I. Y = O

II. Y < O

options.text: Both conclusion I and II are true
options.html: Both conclusion I and II are true

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
options.html: Neither conclusion I nor II is true

questions.solution:
I) Y = O → False (As O = X > Y = Z. So, we get Y < O, therefore is false.)

II) Y < O → True (As O = X > Y = Z. So, we get Y < O, therefore is true.)

Thus, Only conclusion II is true.

questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: The Fundamental Duties are moral obligations intended to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India. While they are not legally enforceable by the courts, they provide a moral framework for citizens to contribute to the nation's growth and social harmony. Assumptions: I. Fundamental Duties act as a guide for citizens to support national integrity. II. Because they lack legal enforcement, Fundamental Duties have no impact on citizen behavior. III. The inclusion of these duties emphasizes the responsibility of the individual toward the state. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: The Fundamental Duties are moral obligations intended to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India. While they are not legally enforceable by the courts, they provide a moral framework for citizens to contribute to the nation's growth and social harmony.

Assumptions: I. Fundamental Duties act as a guide for citizens to support national integrity.

II. Because they lack legal enforcement, Fundamental Duties have no impact on citizen behavior.

III. The inclusion of these duties emphasizes the responsibility of the individual toward the state. ?

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
options.html: Only I and II are implicit

options.text: Only I and III are implicit
options.html: Only I and III are implicit

options.text: All I, II, and III are implicit
options.html: All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
I. Fundamental Duties act as a guide for citizens to support national integrity. → Implicit

The statement promotes patriotism and unity.

II. Because they lack legal enforcement, Fundamental Duties have no impact on citizen behavior. → Not Implicit

The statement clearly says they provide a moral framework, implying they do influence behavior without legal force.

III. The inclusion of these duties emphasizes the responsibility of the individual toward the state → Implicit

The statement states the duties are meant to guide citizens in contributing to national growth and social harmony.

Thus, Only I and III are implicit.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: The municipal authority has increased the parking fee for commercial vehicles in the downtown area. Conclusions: I. Operating commercial vehicles in the downtown area will become more costly. II. Private car owners will start using public transport more frequently. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The municipal authority has increased the parking fee for commercial vehicles in the downtown area.

Conclusions: I. Operating commercial vehicles in the downtown area will become more costly.

II. Private car owners will start using public transport more frequently. ?
questions.solution:
I. Operating commercial vehicles in the downtown area will become more costly. → Follow

This directly follows from the statement, as an increase in parking fees for commercial vehicles clearly raises their operating costs.

II. Private car owners will start using public transport more frequently. → Does not Follow

The statement says nothing about private cars or public transport.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Sales of organic produce in local markets have surged recently. Conclusions: I. Consumers are prioritizing health-conscious food choices. II. Synthetic fertilizers have been banned globally. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: Sales of organic produce in local markets have surged recently.

Conclusions: I. Consumers are prioritizing health-conscious food choices.

II. Synthetic fertilizers have been banned globally. ?
questions.solution:
I. Consumers are prioritizing health-conscious food choices. → Follow

A surge in sales of organic produce reasonably indicates increased consumer preference for healthier or more natural food options.

II. Synthetic fertilizers have been banned globally. → Does not Follow

The statement says nothing about bans or global policies.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: If 12 machines complete a task in 20 days, how many days are needed for 30 machines at the same rate? ?
questions.questionHtml: If 12 machines complete a task in 20 days, how many days are needed for 30 machines at the same rate? ?
questions.solution:
Total work done 12 machines in 20 days = 12 × 20 → 240

So, the same work done by 20 machines in days = 240 ÷ 30 → 8 Days
